snippet: The dataset contains three files:     Illumina_f.fq - forward reads from MiSeq run   Illumina_r_fq - reverse reads from MiSeq run   minion_2d.fq - Oxford Nanopore 2d reads     Sequencing was done on genomic DNA of E. coli strain C-1 obtained from Yale Stock Center.
